senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of קִיר)to storm a wall, batter, destroy.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:6:4">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>בשביעי נכנסו … מְקַרְקְרִין בו וכ׳</he> on the seventh of Ab they entered it, on the eighth they worked to demolish it, on the ninth they set fire to it; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:4:6">Y. Meg. I, 70ᶜ</cite> top; Tosef. Taan. IV (III), 10 <he>והיו מקרקרין שביעי וכ׳</he> they worked at its demolition on the seventh, the eighth &c. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) <he>שהיו מְקַרְקְרִים קירות וכ׳</he> they tore down the walls of their houses and made of them breastworks and placed them around their forts, v. <cite ref="U00478"><he>שׁוֹעַ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 289">Yalk. Is. 289</cite>.
